body: Use the attached sculptural ceramic perfume bottle as a shape and material reference. Produce a studio packshot on seamless white from a distinct elevated three-quarter angle: clearly show the lid top, front body and hollow handle on the side. Keep the cream speckled ceramic, irregular stone-like cap, gold collar, handle opening and original proportions intact. Neutral white balance, crisp edges, generous breathing room, square image. No text or other objects.

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.
instructions.zh-Hans: 按列出的顺序上传参考图。本例使用合成输入素材。
